title: Encrypted Sensitive Record Sync in Rust
summary: This repo now persists encrypted sensitive records, stores provider tokens at rest with explicit key IDs, re-seals stale ciphertext in the background, and syncs a local HTTP-backed provider feed into Postgres.
outcome: Shipped a bounded runtime proof surface for encrypted storage, application-level key rotation, persisted sensitive-access grants, background sync, and audited authorized-read decisions.
highlights: AES-256-GCM protects provider tokens and authorized record payloads at rest, and key-versioned ciphertext keeps mixed-key reads explicit during rotation.
Background token refresh and sync runs keep the proof surface current without widening the public claim surface.
The live lab shows guest-safe redaction, denied signed-in reads without grants, and audited authorized detail reads from the same stored data.

title: Automated Fundraiser Acknowledgment at Scale
summary: Replaced a manual outsourced thank-you workflow with browser automation that could keep up with high-volume fundraiser traffic.
outcome: Roughly 12x per-operator throughput with 72 concurrent workers, clearing a persistent backlog.
highlights: Worker-pool automation pushed browser acknowledgments to 72 concurrent jobs.
Template handling and operator-only steps moved out of the daily workflow.
Improved response speed enough to lift fundraiser chat engagement.

title: Realtime Fundraiser Creation + Donation Signal Pipeline
summary: Built a realtime fundraiser creation and donation pipeline so teams could act on live signals instead of waiting for delayed files.
outcome: Eliminated a 48-hour reporting lag and surfaced donation context in realtime for operations teams.
highlights: Fundraiser creation and donation intake were wired into one live pipeline.
Operators saw donation context immediately instead of waiting for delayed exports.

title: Custom Substack Publishing Pipeline in Rust
summary: Built a Rust monorepo that connected CMS events, queued workers, and publishing automation for Substack-oriented content operations.
outcome: Delivered a deterministic pipeline from Directus webhooks through queued workers to publish actions.
highlights: Directus webhooks fed typed event routing into queued Rust workers.
Publishing actions stayed deterministic from inbound event to Substack delivery.
Queue-backed publishing flow with custom Substack integration.
